item.title: Prajwal Revanna rape case: Key witness reports threat calls after testimony
item.summary: A key witness in the Prajwal Revanna rape trial reported receiving threatening phone calls. She expressed fear for her safety and her son's well-being to the court. The special court has ordered an inquiry into the alleged threats and directed police protection. Officials recently recovered electronic devices from Prajwal Revanna's prison cell. A separate investigation is underway regarding these recovered items.
